page.overview:
Who is Calisa?

While at the , tells that she is looking for men at the . She says that she would not rate any of the men as treasure except for . also mentions that she aims to dig up the buried in the and find out what is inside them. wishes that she had a to cross the desert with ease.

While in the , tells about a rumor of a great treasure buried in the sands. Calisa is also surprised that a runt like wants to cross the desert.

If approach , she will exclaim that she could defeat the monsters if she was a few years younger. If defeats the monsters, she rewards him with a .
